procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ITA 215993 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The Protest Committee was represented by Uros Zvan (International Judge).
facts: During the pre-start of race 1, around 3'30'' - 3'00'' to the start, ITA 215993 was stopped with the sail flapping at the pre- start area around 60 meters from the starting line.
At his time his coach was 10 meters from the sailor, giving verbal instructions for at least 30 seconds.
conclusions: ITA 215993 received help from an outside source and broke RRS 41.
